author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
ECHO features the most projection of any@CirqueduSoleil show, and even Adam Savage was fooled, mistaking projected light for actual light. Tod Harris, head of visuals, explains how the technology works and shows Adam how he and his team can watch a 3D representation of what's happening on stage in real-time.
